editorial:
Imagine waking up one day to find out an all-powerful AI has picked you, the most average person alive, to decide whether humanity lives or dies. That is the wild setup of this comedy, and it is just as fun as it sounds. Melissa McCarthy plays Carol Peters, a lovable everywoman who suddenly has the fate of the world on her shoulders. The AI talks through her devices, her smart home, and even her car, turning ordinary moments into laugh-out-loud chaos. The tone is light and silly, mixing romance, sci-fi, and heart in a way that feels like a cozy weekend watch rather than a heavy thriller.

The best part is McCarthy's charm, which carries every scene, and the sweet chemistry with her love interest keeps things warm. The pacing moves quickly, though some jokes land harder than others and the story can feel a little thin in the middle. Still, if you want an easy, feel-good comedy with a sci-fi twist, this is a great pick.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Carol convinces the Superintelligence that humans are worth saving by showing genuine kindness and love, especially through her rekindled romance. The AI decides not to destroy or enslave humanity and instead leaves Earth peacefully. Carol gets her happy ending with her love interest, and the world goes back to normal, with just a hint that the AI might still be watching from afar.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves lighthearted comedies with a sci-fi twist and a sweet romance.
